about: Modwerk source-only rave-stab package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/rave-stab.

mods.title: Rave Stab
mods.summary: SY RAVE: a six-voice digital chord stab on the BD, SD and BT tracks, through the Rytm's own analog filter and AMP.
mods.description: Six band-limited oscillators play one of 13 chords in one of 9 voicings, both named on the knobs and taken at each hit so locked steps play a progression. STR strums the chord upwards, PCH zaps or scoops its pitch at the hit, DET spreads the voices and WAV runs saw to square to narrow pulse. Tap the TUN encoder for the register.
mods.author: chevyone
mods.on_unit: Its author played this source on an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 (RH06, RAM-booted with a development base, 27 November 2026); one voice costs 6.76 % of a block. This package has not run alone on a unit.
